description: This Java class, ValidateUtil, provides utility methods for validating objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It facilitates validation before saving objects, manages validation enabling/disabling, checks field lengths, and interacts with OpenMRS services for validation logic.

classes.name: ValidateUtil
classes.description: A utility class for object validation in OpenMRS, offering static methods to validate objects, handle validation states, and check field lengths, primarily used within service layers.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given object using registered validation logic; throws ValidationException if errors are found.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given object and populates provided Errors object with validation results.

methods.name: validateFieldLengths
methods.description: Checks if specified string fields in an object exceed their maximum configured lengths, adds errors if so.

methods.name: getDisableValidation
methods.description: Returns whether validation is globally disabled.

methods.name: setDisableValidation
methods.description: Sets whether validation is globally disabled.

methods.name: isValidationDisabledForThread
methods.description: Checks if validation is disabled for the current thread.

methods.name: disableValidationForThread
methods.description: Disables validation for the current thread.

methods.name: resumeValidationForThread
methods.description: Re-enables validation for the current thread.
